each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Overlay the two panels separated by a solid-color divider; mark shared filled cells."""
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0]) if h else 0
    # The divider is the full-height column containing the separator color (5).
    divider = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 5 for r in range(h))), None)
    if divider is None:
        raise ValueError("No full-height divider found")
    left_w = divider
    right_w = w - divider - 1
    if left_w != right_w:
        raise ValueError("Panels have unequal widths")
    return [
        [2 if grid[r][c] != 0 and grid[r][divider + 1 + c] != 0 else 0
         for c in range(left_w)]
        for r in range(h)
    ]
